_comment: Zepp OS (console.zepp.com) submission bundle for Dragon Army. Fill these values into Console > Create App > Submit for review. Spec sources: https://docs.zepp.com/docs/distribute/ (submission fields, 360x360 screenshots, 240x240 icon), https://docs.zepp.com/docs/designs/visual/icons/ (circle icon rules), https://docs.zepp.com/docs/reference/app-json/ (app.json), https://docs.zepp.com/docs/reference/related-resources/device-list/ (devices), https://docs.zepp.com/docs/reference/related-resources/language-list/ (language codes).

countryOrRegion.note: Publish to all regions available on console.zepp.com. The game is English-only and contains no region-specific content. If Console forces per-country checkboxes, tick all non-China-mainland countries first; add Mainland China only after confirming deviceSource variants (* = China) install correctly. See device-list docs for *-marked China variants.

appCategory.note: Select the Games/Entertainment category (Console > App Classification). Fallback if 'Games' is absent: 'Entertainment'.

package.howToRebuild: zeus build (zpm 3.x) from repo root, or `npm run build:engine` + Console upload. Rebuild the .zab immediately before submitting so version.code/name and appId match app.json. The .zab in dist/ was built 2026-09-21 from app.json version 1.0.0 (code 1).
package.note: Upload in Console > Application Package. appId inside the package must equal the registered appId (20003) and the app name must not collide with your other apps.

supportedDevices.detection: Auto-filled by Console after the .zab upload, from app.json targets + runtime.apiVersion.minVersion.
supportedDevices.primaryTestedDevice: Amazfit Bip 6 (square 390x450, API_LEVEL 4.2, deviceSource 9765120) — tap-only UI, no swipe.
expectedDevices: Other Zepp OS 4.0+ square 390x450 devices (e.g. Amazfit Active, GTS 4, Active 2 Square, Cheetah Square)
Zepp OS 4.0+ round devices 480x480 / 466x466 (e.g. Balance / Balance 2, T-Rex 3 / Ultra 2, Active 2 Round, Cheetah 2 series) via the round 480 target
supportedDevices.note: Requires Zepp OS runtime >= 4.0 (app.json runtime.apiVersion.minVersion). If Console lists unexpected devices after upload, update app.json targets/platforms to explicit deviceSource numbers from the device-list docs and rebuild.

version.note: Auto-recognized from the .zab on upload. Bump BOTH code (+1) and name (semver) in app.json for every Version Upgrade submission.

supportedLanguages.note: Only en-US is declared in app.json i18n. All in-game strings are English. Add more locales to app.json i18n + in-game text before ticking other languages in Console > Language.

shortDescription.en-US: Hatch, train and battle dragons. Defeat monsters and the Bewilder Beast!

fullDescription.en-US:
Dragon Army is a tap-only pet-battler for Zepp OS, inspired by How to Train Your Dragon.

Hatch dragon eggs, train your dragons, and fight spawn-based monsters to earn coins and permanent strength. When ready, take your whole roster into turn-based battle against the Bewilder Beast boss — survivors gain bonus strength, the fallen are removed, and the beast respawns after a day.

HOW TO PLAY
- Buy Egg (top-left): spin-then-pay — tap to freeze the spin, OK to pay 100 coins. Eggs hatch in 24-48h real time.
- Train: costs coins (scales with strength) + 15 energy, +2-5 strength (max 125). Strength shows as stars: 5 strength = 1 silver star, 5 silver = 1 gold.
- Fight monsters: only spawned monsters (0-3) can be fought. Wins give coins + permanent strength; losses cost energy.
- Bewilder Beast (top-right): all dragons with energy > 0 attack in roster order; the beast hits back on energy. Win: +2-4 strength per survivor + 300 coins, beast vanishes for a day.
- Earn Coins: hourly coins (2/hour, up to 12h) plus a walking bonus (100 steps = 1 coin) are credited only by tapping the coin icon when it appears. Energy recovers passively (10/hour).

DETAILS
- Tap-only navigation (roster strip + Home); no swipe.
- Progress is stored on-device only; no account, no network.
- Tested on Amazfit Bip 6 (390x450). Also supports Zepp OS 4.0+ round and square watches (see Supported devices).
- Version 1.0.0.

previewScreenshots.spec: PNG, 360x360px, transparent background, app UI maximally displayed. Rectangular (square-watch) screenshots: UI height fills 360px, centered horizontally with equal left/right transparent margins and no top/bottom margins. 3+ screenshots recommended. Source: docs/distribute App Introduction Screenshots.

privacyStatement.en-US: Dragon Army does not collect, transmit, or share any personal data. All game progress (coins, dragons, eggs, settings) is stored locally on the watch only (device local storage, file dragon_army_data.txt) and never leaves the device. The app requests on-device permissions only (device info for runtime compatibility, local storage for save data, step counter for the walking coin bonus), shows no ads, uses no analytics, requires no account, and makes no network requests. Contact: dragon-army vendor via the Zepp developer console.

requiredPermissions.consoleMapping: In Console > Calling Permissions tick only what the app uses. All permissions are on-device only:

purposes.purpose: Read device model/runtime info for screen compatibility. No personal data collected.
Save/load game progress locally on the watch (dragon_army_data.txt). Never transmitted.
Read the on-device step counter for the walking coin bonus (100 steps = 1 coin). Steps never leave the device.

requiredPermissions.sensitiveData: Step count only (on-device, for the coin bonus) — no contacts, location, microphone, or account data accessed.

containsThirdPartySDKs.details: No third-party SDKs. The package bundles only first-party Zepp OS APIs plus @zeppos/zml (Zepp official UI helper, no data collection) and self-authored game code. No ads, analytics, crash-reporting, or network SDKs.
